reasoning: Dpm2 is a subunit of the dolichyl‑phosphate‑mannose synthase complex; loss of Dpm2 impairs N‑glycosylation and triggers endoplasmic‑reticulum stress, activating the PERK branch of the unfolded‑protein response. PERK‑mediated eIF2α phosphorylation induces ATF4, and ATF4 has been reported to up‑regulate Hilpda (a hypoxia‑responsive, lipid‑droplet associated gene) in stress conditions. Hence the knockout is expected to increase Hilpda transcription.
